subject: India
note: Hand-curated from the pinned World Bank series (public/geo/series.json): population (SP.POP.TOTL), 1960 and 2023. Each figure is the table's figure for that country and year, rounded in the text. Ratios are computed from those figures.

claims.text: China had 667 million people in 1960 and 1.41 billion in 2023, about 2.1 times as many.
India had 436 million people in 1960 and 1.44 billion in 2023, about 3.3 times as many.
Nigeria had 45 million people in 1960 and 228 million in 2023, about 5 times as many.
Ethiopia had 21 million people in 1960 and 129 million in 2023, about 6 times as many.
The Democratic Republic of the Congo had 15 million people in 1960 and 106 million in 2023, nearly 7 times as many.
Japan had 93 million people in 1960 and 125 million in 2023, about 1.3 times as many.
